posts.en:
dsh-punky-swarm#dsh-punky-swarm is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Single-machine multi-subagent swarm governance for DeepSeek Harness: fixed-semantics wavePlan (3-layer DAG), engine-enforced Tier3 gates (Entry/L0/Exit/Complete), state machine, locks/mailbox, session isolation, plus the Punky Mode preset and jiufeng-team role guide.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-f2263bc221b5cd76415d.html
